question: To whom must the sacred teaching never be given under any circumstances?
premises: The teaching must not be given to a reviler of Shiva.
It must not be given to a slanderer of Kula Bhairava.
inference: Revilers of Shiva and Kula Bhairava are strictly excluded from receiving the teaching.
plain_english: O Goddess, it must not be given to one who reviles Shiva or slanders Kula Bhairava.
